rationale: RCL has gapped up ~6.9% on elevated relative volume (5.68x) and is sitting at 97% of today's range, just 0.08% below the session high — momentum is extended with price far above VWAP ($303.74) and the 9-EMA ($300.37). The wide bid-ask spread (47 bps) and the fact that the stock is already near its intraday high after a large gap make both a long chase and a short fade high-risk: a long risks buying exhaustion at the top of a gap, while a short fights strong upward momentum with no clear technical resistance overhead. With no clean setup and existing working orders already consuming buying power, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
